content: पिशुन {%a.%} [पिश्-उनच् किच्च; <ls>Uṇ. 3. 55</ls>] .²1 .³({%a%}) Indicating, manifesting, evincing, displaying, indicative of; शत्रूनामनिशं विनाशपिशुनः <ls>Śi. 1. 75</ls>; तुल्यानुरागपिशुनम् <ls>V. 2. 14</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 53</ls>; <ls>Amaru. 97</ls>. .³({%b%}) Memorable for, commemorating; क्षेत्रं क्षत्रप्रधनपिशुनं कौरवं तद् भजेथाः <ls>Me. 48</ls>. .²2 Slanderous, back-biting, calumniating; पिशुनजनं खलु बिभ्रति क्षितीन्द्राः <ls>Bv. 1. 74</ls>. .²3 Betraying, treacherous. .²4 Harsh, cruel, unkind. .²5 Wicked, malicious; malignant. .²6 Low, vile, contemptible; of a wicked person; पिशुनं भोजनं भुङ्क्ते ब्रह्महत्यासमं विदुः <ls>Mb. 13. 136. 16</ls>. .²7 Foolish, stupid. .{@-नः@} .²1 A slanderer, back-biter, tale-bearer, base informer, traitor, calumniator; वरं प्राणत्यागो न च पिशुनवाक्येष्वभिरुचिः <ls>H. 1. 116</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 304</ls>; <ls>Ms. 3. 161</ls>; पिशुनता यद्यस्ति किं पातकैः <ls>Bh. 1. 55</ls>. .²2 Cotton. .²3 An epithet of Nārada. .²4 A crow. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of a goblin (said to be dangerous to pregnant women). .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of a writer on अर्थशास्त्र mentioned by Kauṭilya in connection with राजपुत्ररक्षण; <ls>Kau.
